column3: scores the sprint as a whole and defaults to Full; a lower rating needs a written evidence note the student can see and answer
column6: The student owned at least one piece of work someone else accepted this sprint, and its pull request, issue, or document shows the student authored or drove it; for work a grader cannot open, the TA confirms this at the check-in. Other work of theirs still open or in review at sprint close does not lower it. A sprint where the whole team was blocked, stated in the note, also scores Full.
column9: The student has no accepted piece this sprint, and their owned work is written up and in review at sprint close (an open pull request, issue, or document with review activity this sprint). A piece scores In review once; the next sprint it counts only if accepted.
column12: The student has no accepted piece this sprint, and their only work is reviews, routine upkeep (a formatter run, a lockfile bump, a rename, or a ticket moved on the board), work whose write-up does not show the student's part, or owned work still open at sprint close with no review activity.
column15: No contribution this sprint, or a contribution the linked work or the check-in contradicts. Being blocked alone is not an explanation: there is other work to pick up.
